title: Missions
summary: Gameplay is initiated for all characters at a common entry point: The Brainiac Harvester Ship. From there, based on the Mentors and morality chosen, the player character is assigned a series of Mentor-based Missions. Missions are the main way to gain experience which is required to increase level in the game. Missions are tracked and designated active via the Journal tab on the Menu Interface.

summary: Dispenser Items are provided by Dispensers, a vendor-like base amenity. Different items are available to the player depending on how many dispenser item levels have been unlocked and how many power cells are activated in the base's mainframe. Once unlocked with Source Marks, the items can generally be taken unlimited times with no additional cost. Dispenser Items require Lair System access.
